title: Differences in hepatic metabolism of Liandan Xiaoyan Formula between control and ulcerative colitis mice associated with FXR/PXR-CYP450 changes.
authors: Zheng, Baojun; Chen, Yingzhu; Fan, Bingshuang; Dai, Pengyu; Zhou, Rui; Li, Shengnan; Liang, Leyao; Lin, Chaozhan; Liu, Fangle; Zhu, Chenchen
journal: Journal of pharmaceutical and biomedical analysis
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方在溃疡性结肠炎小鼠中的肝代谢差异及FXR/PXR-CYP450变化，仅用分子对接预测CYP450亚型，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Understanding the metabolic process of traditional Chinese prescription (TCP) during disease states and its underlying mechanisms is crucial for evaluating therapeutic efficacy and safety. Cytochrome P450 (CYP450)-mediated hepatic metabolism plays a key role in this process. Liandan Xiaoyan Formula (LDXYF), a Chinese herbal prescription used to treat enteritis, exhibits different pharmacokinetic characteristics and metabolic profiles in ulcerative colitis (UC). To elucidate its underlying metabolic mechanisms, UPLC-Q-Exactive Orbitrap MS/MS technology was employed to compare the metabolite profiles of its six main effective components in hepatic microsomes from control versus UC mice. Molecular docking was employed to predict the dominant CYP450 isoforms involved. Subsequently, a CYP450 enzyme selective inhibition assay was used to identify the metabolic enzyme phenotypes for each component. Finally, RT-qPCR and Western blot analyses were conducted to confirm the expression changes of key isoforms and their regulatory targets. Metabolite profiling revealed that the biotransformation of LDXYF components was markedly suppressed in UC mice, with hydrogenation, carboxylation, hydroxylation, and demethylation being the most attenuated. The CYP450 phenotypes were identified as: CYP2D22/2C29 for andrographolide; CYP2C29 for dehydroandrographolide; CYP2D22/2C29 for 14-deoxyandrographolide; CYP2C29 for 1-methoxycarbonyl-beta-carboline; CYP2D22/2C29 for 4,5-dimethoxycanthin-6-one; and CYP2C29 for 5-hydroxy-4-methoxycanthin-6-one. Furthermore, hepatic CYP2D22 and CYP2C29 were confirmed to be down-regulated at both mRNA and protein levels in UC, which correlated with reduced expression of the bile-acid receptors farnesoid X receptor (FXR) and pregnane X receptor (PXR) and the transcription factor hepatocyte nuclear factor 4 alpha (HNF4alpha). In conclusion, UC is associated with suppressed LDXYF metabolism and reduced hepatic CYP450 expression, accompanied by altered FXR/PXR-related signaling, thereby providing mechanistic insight into drug-disease interactions.
abstract_zh: 理解中药复方（TCP）在疾病状态下的代谢过程及其潜在机制，对于评估疗效和安全性至关重要。细胞色素P450（CYP450）介导的肝脏代谢在此过程中发挥关键作用。莲胆消炎方（LDXYF）是一种用于治疗肠炎的中药复方，在溃疡性结肠炎（UC）中表现出不同的药代动力学特征和代谢谱。为阐明其潜在代谢机制，采用UPLC-Q-Exactive Orbitrap MS/MS技术，比较了其六个主要有效成分在对照小鼠与UC小鼠肝微粒体中的代谢物谱。利用分子对接预测参与的主要CYP450亚型。随后，通过CYP450酶选择性抑制实验，鉴定各成分的代谢酶表型。最后，采用RT-qPCR和Western blot分析，确认关键亚型及其调控靶点的表达变化。代谢物谱分析显示，UC小鼠中LDXYF成分的生物转化显著受抑，其中氢化、羧化、羟基化和去甲基化反应减弱最为明显。CYP450表型鉴定结果为：穿心莲内酯对应CYP2D22/2C29；脱水穿心莲内酯对应CYP2C29；14-去氧穿心莲内酯对应CYP2D22/2C29；1-甲氧基羰基-β-咔啉对应CYP2C29；4,5-二甲氧基铁屎米酮对应CYP2D22/2C29；5-羟基-4-甲氧基铁屎米酮对应CYP2C29。此外，在UC中，肝脏CYP2D22和CYP2C29在mRNA和蛋白水平均被证实下调，这与胆汁酸受体法尼醇X受体（FXR）和孕烷X受体（PXR）及转录因子肝细胞核因子4α（HNF4alpha）的表达降低相关。总之，UC与LDXYF代谢受抑及肝脏CYP450表达降低相关，并伴随FXR/PXR相关信号通路改变，从而为药物-疾病相互作用提供机制性见解。
